test_title: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper (Held On: 12th September 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Consider the following statements regarding India’s water treaties:

1) The Mahakali Treaty signed with Nepal in 1996 promotes cooperation in river development.

2) The Ganga Water Treaty with Bangladesh ensures year-round sharing of Ganga waters.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only 1 is correct**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1:** The **Mahakali Treaty** was signed between India and Nepal in **1996**. This treaty primarily focuses on the cooperation between the two nations for the integrated development of the **Mahakali River**, which includes projects like **Pancheshwar Multipurpose Project**. It aims to utilize the river’s potential for irrigation, power generation, and flood control. *Hence, statement 1 is correct.*
 
• **Statement 2 **The **Ganga Water Sharing Treaty (1996)** between India and Bangladesh provides for the **sharing of the Ganga waters during the dry season (January to May)** at Farakka. It does **not** ensure year-round sharing — only seasonal sharing during the lean flow period.. *Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mahakali Treaty:**

 
 
• The **Mahakali Treaty** was signed on **February 12, 1996**, to promote bilateral cooperation between India and Nepal.
 
• The treaty covers projects like the **Pancheshwar Multipurpose Project**, aiming to harness the river’s potential for **hydropower generation, irrigation, and flood control.**
 
• It emphasizes the principle of **equal entitlement** to the waters of the Mahakali River, fostering mutual cooperation.
 
 
 
• **Ganga Water Treaty:**
 
 
• Signed on **December 12, 1996**, between India and Bangladesh, the treaty focuses on the **equitable sharing** of Ganga waters during the lean season (January to May).
 
• It ensures a minimum flow of water to Bangladesh and provides a framework for resolving disputes related to water sharing.
 
• The treaty is based on the principle of **sustainable water management** and aims to strengthen relations between the two nations.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of Mahakali Treaty:**

 
 
• It promotes **joint development** of water resources and the construction of projects like **Pancheshwar Multipurpose Project.**
 
• The treaty ensures **equal rights** to the waters of the Mahakali River for both countries.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of Ganga Water Treaty:**
 
 
• It ensures **year-round sharing** of Ganga waters at Farakka Barrage, especially during the lean season.
 
• It emphasizes **cooperation** between India and Bangladesh to address water-related issues.
